1: 1. Say, O Messenger: “I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind and seek His protection.”
2: 2. “The King of the people, who does whatever He wishes with them. They do not have any real king other than Him.”
3: 3. “He is their rightful deity; they do not have any rightful deity except Him.”
4: 4. “From the evils of Satan who whispers to the human when he is neglectful of the remembrance of Allah, or delays in it when he remembers.”
5: 5. “He whispers to the hearts of people.”
6: 6. “And he could be from the humankind or from the Jinn.”
